fragments.text: Listen to the voice of those who glorify Thee with all their limbs, the number of whose commandments corresponds to their two hundred and fortyeight bones. On this New Moon they blow thirty blasts, like the thirty bones in the ball of their foot. The gift of homage of the Musaph sacrifice for the day numbers ten, like the ten bones in their ankles. They approach the Holy Ark twice in the morning, like the two bones in their thighs. Five are appointed to read the Torah on it, like the five bones in their knees. They are commanded to blow the Shofar on the first of the month, corresponding to the one bone in their hip. Three times do they sound long blasts on the horn, like the three bones of the hip-joint. The Musaph sacrifices of the New Moon are eleven in number, like their eleven ribs. Softly do they pour forth the prayer with the nine blessings, like the nine bones in their arm. There are thirty verses in Malkhuyoth, Zikhronoth and Shofaroth, like the thirty bones in their hand. The daily prayer consists of eighteen blessings, like the eighteen vertebrae in their spine. During the daily sacrifice they blow nine times, like the nine bones in their head. In the two prayers (morning and Musaph) they bow down eight times altogether like the eight bones in their neck. Their Torah is divided into five books, like the five organs of the senses in their cavities.

The paths of the world (Mishnah) did He draw for them in six divisions, like the six divisions of the heart. Kidneys, loins, heart, brain, body, intestines with their sensations, soul, spirit, breath, personality, life-force, skin, flesh, sinews, and their bones.

They raise their eye, listen with the ear, open the mouth and speak; from the ball of the foot to the head every single action of theirs is examined when the Shofar is blown; at this sound their accusers blush, for they hear their justification for the second time on the day of judgment from their God.

title.en: Listen to the voice of those who glorify Thee
